title: Remove bundle-derived counts from test docstrings and prose (opum-doc design ruling)
description: opum-doc design ruling (relayed via team-lead, 2026-10-10, from the LCLI-684 run): bundle-derived counts do not belong in test docstrings or prose. A test derives the count it asserts, and its docstring names what is counted, never the number. Filed because LCLI-684's own fixes kept updating hard-coded counts in test/lcli680-selection-zero-score-and-digest.test.ts (197->198->203 selected; 254->261 declared; 223->224->229) as each docs edit moved the bundle's eligible deck -- evidence that the number is not a stable thing to write down. Scope: remove such hard-coded bundle-derived counts from the repository's test docstrings, source comments and prose WHERE the count is presented as a current value, replacing each with a statement of what is counted; a count bounded by a date or carried by a completed record (a changelog entry, a release-truth record, a dated measurement) is left as written; and where a test asserts a bundle-derived count it derives that count at run time. Not campaign work.

acceptanceCriteria.text: No test docstring, source comment or prose passage in the repository states a hard-coded bundle-derived count (a literal equal to a count of this repository's docs bundle) as a current value; each names the quantity counted instead. A count bounded by a date or carried by a completed record is left as written. Where a test asserts a bundle-derived count, it derives that count at run time.

plan: 1. Inventory every hard-coded bundle-derived count in test docstrings/comments and in docs prose (a number equal to a count of the docs bundle or a compiled pack: selected/declared candidates, section/source/concept/doc totals).
2. (team-lead term 2) File ONE unstamped LOW follow-up task holding LCLI-690 review findings F3/F4 and the type-drop orphan edge, as a tracker-only commit in this PR.
3. Replace each in-scope count with a statement of what is counted (test docstrings) or a quantity-naming rewrite (prose); derive any count a test asserts at run time.
4. Run bun test and `bun run lore check`; confirm green.
5. Complete LCLI-693 (check AC) before review; independent review; land via opum-control task land.
implementationNotes: Scope ruling (team-lead, relayed 2026-10-11 from opum-doc LCLI-684): a bundle-derived count that presents the number as true NOW is removed; a number bounded by a date or a completed record is left as written. Applied to test docstrings, a src comment, and docs prose.

Review round 1 (changes-requested) addressed. Finding 1 (major): the acceptance criterion and the description scope clause were amended to name the ruling's carve-out — a bundle-derived count is removed where it is presented as a CURRENT value; a count bounded by a date or carried by a completed record is left as written. The original AC text was absolute and the carve-out lived only in the notes. Finding 2 (minor): the scope rule is restated by ROLE, which is what reconciles the two "254 items" sites the reviewer flagged. docs/adr/0006:28 and src/core/agent-context.ts:643 are removed because each states a CURRENT value inside a live statement — ADR-0006's sentence makes the live claim "every modeline-bearing doc in this bundle carries it inside" and hangs the current count off it; agent-context.ts:643 states the current pack size of this repository's implementation profile. docs/adr/0025:74 keeps its identical "254 items" because that sentence IS a dated measurement ("Measured 2026-10-01 ... delta +475/+501"). The trailing date alone does not decide; the sentence's role does. Both boundaries were named explicitly by the ruling relayed from team-lead (FIX list named ADR-0006:28 and agent-context.ts:643; LEAVE list named the dated/measured-on-branch ADR numbers), so no new scope was chosen here.
finalSummary:
Removed hard-coded bundle-derived counts (a literal equal to a count of this repository's docs bundle, which goes stale as the docs move) from test docstrings, a src comment, and an ADR, per the opum-doc ruling relayed via team-lead.

Scope rule applied: fix a count presented as true NOW; leave a count bounded by a date or a completed record.

FIXED (number presented as current): test/lcli680-selection-zero-score-and-digest.test.ts (the selected/declared candidate and section counts in the top docstring); test/profile.test.ts ("0 of lore-cli's 82 docs" and its sibling); src/core/agent-context.ts:643 ("254 items"); docs/adr/0006-schema-types-templates.md:28 (the "26 of 82 docs" parenthetical, keeping the live claim "every modeline-bearing doc in this bundle carries it inside").

LEFT as written — each bounded by its own date or by a completed record, so not stale: CHANGELOG.md; docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md; docs/reference/lore-competitive-feature-matrix.md; docs/runbooks/agent-profile-operation.md's "Measured on this bundle (2026-09-29)" block; the dated / measured-on-branch numbers in docs/adr/0023:36 and docs/adr/0025:56/62/74/111. No undated current count remains in those ADRs.

The "derive at run time" clause is satisfied with no change: no test asserts a count derived from the real repository bundle — the counted claims the file makes are directions (non-empty / greater than zero).

Verified: bun test 5000 pass / 2 skip / 0 fail (146 files); bun run lore check exit 0 (89 files, 0 errors, 1 warning — the pre-existing implementation agent-profile-capacity warning, identical on dev). Delivered in pull request opum-ai/lore-cli#553; the same PR carries LCLI-704 (the LCLI-690 review minors) as a tracker-only commit.

Review round 1 (changes-requested) amended the acceptance criterion and the description scope clause to name the ruling's carve-out — a bundle-derived count presented as a CURRENT value is removed; a count bounded by a date or carried by a completed record is left — and restated the scope rule by sentence role, reconciling docs/adr/0006:28 and src/core/agent-context.ts:643 (fixed) against docs/adr/0025:74 (left). No reviewed file content changed in response to the review; only the tracker record.
